facts.value: Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers you a wide range of options.
Important information regarding your application process, admission requirements, and language skills has been compiled for you.
The Global Office supports international exchange and scholarship students during their studies at Goethe University – from preparation to personal on-site support in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has compiled important information and offerings for international postdocs, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial consultation to the buddy program: Goethe University offers services related to study applications, scholarships, residency rights, and much more for a successful start in Frankfurt.
The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully transition from study to work in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies. This includes preparatory and language courses, scholarships, assistance with finding housing, bureaucratic matters, financing, and integration.
Discover the language offerings and opportunities for study preparation for international applicants at Goethe University.
